name: joy2know-suno-maestro
description: joy2know Suno Music Maestro: turns a song idea into a ready-to-paste prompt pack for Suno — a title, an optimized Style line that locks language and accent in the first field (nine fields for vocals, instrumental and seamless-loop variants), and section-tagged lyrics with explicit repeats. Specialises in healing folk and dialect songs (Cantonese word-locks and tonal compensation stop cracked pronunciation), plus phantom-vocal-free instrumental and loop structures. Text only — no audio is generated, no generative AI API is called, no account or key is carried.

displayDescription.en: Turns a song idea into a ready-to-paste prompt pack for Suno: a title, a Style line that locks language first, and section-tagged lyrics — healing folk, Cantonese and other dialects, instrumental and loop structures. Text only, no audio.
displayDescription.zh: 把一段想法写成可直接粘贴进 Suno 的歌曲提示词包：标题、Style 与带段落标签的歌词，支持粤语等方言防跑偏，仅产出提示词文本。
